description: A voltage-controlled panner and crossfader, moving one input between two outputs or two inputs into one

params.text: Sets the position, marked 5 to 0 to 5 either side of centre
Picks between panning one input across two outputs and fading two inputs into one

inputs.text: Panned across both outputs in Pan, or faded against the second input in Fade
Faded against the first input in Fade, and not read in Pan
Moves the position, a tenth of the knob's range per volt, and the total is clamped at the ends

outputs.text: The first input at its panned level in Pan, or the two inputs mixed in Fade
The first input at its opposite panned level in Pan, and silent in Fade
